Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

random.seed(21)
scene = Scene('Quiet classroom')

# Front wall, painted lower wall, and a narrow strip of wooden floor.
scene.include('wall', box((9,.18,5), center=(0,.13,2.5), color=(.79,.78,.70)))
scene.include('blue_lower_wall', box((9,.025,1.31), center=(0,.023,.655), color=(.015,.105,.28)))
scene.include('floor', box((10,12,.12), center=(0,-4,-.065), color=(.56,.37,.19)))
scene.include('skirting', box((9,.035,.045), center=(0,-.005,.026), color=(.51,.40,.28)))

# Two worn green chalkboard panels, with an extremely thin rim.
board = Asset('chalkboard')
board.include('backing', box((5.03,.075,1.69), center=(0,-.045,1.88), color=(.12,.17,.105)))
board.include('left_panel', box((2.49,.018,1.655), center=(-1.255,-.092,1.88), color=(.055,.18,.105)))
board.include('right_panel', box((2.49,.018,1.655), center=(1.255,-.092,1.88), color=(.055,.15,.083)))
board.include('center_seam', box((.012,.018,1.665), center=(0,-.108,1.88), color=(.15,.22,.13)))
for x in (-2.512,2.512):
    board.include('edge'+str(x), box((.016,.026,1.69), center=(x,-.096,1.88), color=(.19,.23,.15)))
scene.include('board',board)

# Layered chalk dust and wiping streaks, made from separate fine marks.
marks=Asset('chalk residue')
def stroke(name,points,radius,color):
    if len(points)>1:
        marks.include(name,sweep_tube(points=points,radius=radius,color=color))
for i in range(300):
    x=random.uniform(.025,2.47)
    z0=random.uniform(1.06,2.54)
    z1=min(2.697,z0+random.uniform(.12,1.1))
    intensity=max(0,1-x/2.65)
    c=random.choice([
        (.12,.235,.145),(.17,.27,.175),(.22,.30,.205),
        (.27,.34,.24),(.10,.205,.12)])
    c=tuple(v*(.65+.35*intensity) for v in c)
    bend=random.uniform(-.04,.04)
    pts=[(x+bend*math.sin(t*2.7),-.109-random.random()*.001,z0+(z1-z0)*t)
         for t in (0,.15,.35,.55,.75,1)]
    stroke('vertical_wipe_%d'%i,pts,random.uniform(.001,.009),c)

for i in range(260):
    x=random.uniform(-2.46,-.04)
    z=random.uniform(1.08,2.67)
    length=random.uniform(.025,.42)
    if random.random()<.62:
        pts=[(x+.009*math.sin(t*5+i),-.112,z-t*length) for t in (0,.25,.5,.75,1) if z-t*length>1.06]
    else:
        pts=[(min(-.025,x+t*length),-.112,z+.009*math.sin(t*7+i)) for t in (0,.25,.5,.75,1)]
    stroke('left_smear_%d'%i,pts,random.uniform(.001,.005),
           random.choice([(.17,.31,.205),(.23,.36,.25),(.32,.42,.29),(.12,.27,.17)]))

# Broad curving eraser traces, concentrated over the left panel.
for i in range(48):
    cx=random.uniform(-1.28,-.75)
    cz=random.uniform(2.12,2.30)
    rx=random.uniform(.25,.72)
    rz=random.uniform(.16,.40)
    a0=random.uniform(-1.2,3.0)
    span=random.uniform(.55,2.9)
    pts=[]
    for j in range(24):
        a=a0+span*j/23
        x=cx+rx*math.cos(a)
        z=cz+rz*math.sin(a)
        if -2.46<x<-.035 and 1.07<z<2.69:
            pts.append((x,-.117,z))
    stroke('eraser_arc_%d'%i,pts,random.uniform(.003,.014),
           random.choice([(.17,.29,.19),(.23,.34,.23),(.30,.39,.27),(.12,.25,.16)]))

# Sparse remnants of chalk handwriting and small white flecks.
for row in range(7):
    z=1.37+row*.145
    for k in range(random.randint(9,19)):
        x=random.uniform(-2.39,-1.02)
        h=random.uniform(.018,.059)
        pts=[(x,-.121,z),(x+.012,-.121,z+h),
             (x+.034,-.121,z+h*.3),(x+.046,-.121,z+h*.65)]
        stroke('faded_letter_%d_%d'%(row,k),pts,.0018,(.32,.43,.30))
for i in range(65):
    x=random.uniform(-2.46,2.45)
    z=random.uniform(1.08,2.67)
    stroke('chalk_speck_%d'%i,[(x,-.123,z),(x+.003,-.123,z+random.uniform(.004,.027))],
           .0018,(.48,.53,.37))
scene.include('residue',marks)

# Small hanging printed notice above the board.
notice=Asset('wall notice')
notice.include('paper_edge',box((.91,.016,.718),center=(.21,-.004,3.325),color=(.62,.56,.43)))
notice.include('paper',box((.883,.008,.697),center=(.205,-.017,3.331),color=(.82,.79,.70)))
for col in range(3):
    x=-.185+col*.276
    for row in range(19):
        z=3.611-row*.029
        w=random.uniform(.09,.23)
        notice.include('print_%d_%d'%(col,row),
                       box((w,.002,random.choice([.002,.003,.004])),center=(x+w/2,-.024,z),
                           color=(.40,.39,.34)))
notice.include('heading',box((.47,.002,.009),center=(.22,-.026,3.647),color=(.39,.37,.31)))
notice.include('rule',box((.81,.002,.002),center=(.205,-.026,3.59),color=(.51,.47,.39)))
notice.include('left_string',rod(.0018,start=(-.24,-.013,3.69),end=(.20,.005,4.02),color=(.51,.47,.37)))
notice.include('right_string',rod(.0018,start=(.65,-.013,3.69),end=(.20,.005,4.02),color=(.51,.47,.37)))
for x in (-.225,.64):
    notice.include('pin'+str(x),ball(.011,center=(x,-.031,3.665),color=(.61,.39,.17)))
scene.include('notice',notice)
scene.include('wall_hook',ball(.047,center=(-.42,-.026,3.52),color=(.12,.095,.075)))
scene.include('hook_center',ball(.016,center=(-.423,-.067,3.531),color=(.40,.34,.26)))

# School desks: honey-colored wooden tops and gray tubular frames.
def desk(name,x,y,width,depth,height,cream=False):
    a=Asset(name)
    topcolor=(.72,.63,.46) if cream else (.83,.56,.22)
    a.include('top',fillet_box((width,depth,.052),radius=.028,
                             center=(x,y,height),color=topcolor))
    a.include('front_edge',box((width-.055,.021,.027),
                              center=(x,y-depth/2-.001,height-.009),
                              color=(.68,.43,.16) if not cream else (.57,.49,.36)))
    for sx in (-1,1):
        lx=x+sx*(width/2-.11)
        for sy in (-1,1):
            ly=y+sy*(depth/2-.075)
            a.include('leg_%s_%s'%(sx,sy),rod(.017,start=(lx,ly,height-.035),
                                           end=(lx+sx*.035,ly+sy*.05,.055),
                                           color=(.43,.47,.43)))
            a.include('foot_%s_%s'%(sx,sy),box((.046,.055,.035),
                                           center=(lx+sx*.035,ly+sy*.05,.037),color=(.16,.17,.15)))
        a.include('sidebar'+str(sx),rod(.013,start=(lx,y-depth/2+.06,.30),
                                      end=(lx,y+depth/2-.06,.30),color=(.41,.44,.40)))
    a.include('under_top_rail',box((width-.16,.035,.045),center=(x,y+.13,height-.093),color=(.39,.43,.40)))
    for i in range(19):
        xx=x+random.uniform(-width*.46,width*.46)
        yy=y+random.uniform(-depth*.4,depth*.4)
        a.include('woodgrain_%d'%i,box((random.uniform(.04,.35),.001,.0006),
                    center=(xx,yy,height+.0264),
                    color=(.69,.46,.20) if not cream else (.63,.56,.43)))
    scene.include(name,a)

desk('middle desk',-.54,-2.0,1.99,.58,.815)
desk('foreground desk',-.68,-3.33,2.10,.65,.72)
desk('right foreground desk',2.12,-3.30,1.64,.66,.71,True)

def chair(name,x,y,width=.51,backheight=1.03):
    a=Asset(name)
    wood=(.64,.35,.12)
    a.include('seat',fillet_box((width,.43,.035),radius=.018,center=(x,y,.46),color=(.69,.41,.15)))
    back=box((width,.045,.255),center=(x,y+.19,backheight-.1275),color=wood)
    back.turn('y',-3)
    a.include('back',back)
    for sx in (-1,1):
        xx=x+sx*(width/2-.045)
        a.include('rear_support'+str(sx),rod(.012,start=(xx,y+.18,.06),end=(xx,y+.215,backheight-.025),color=(.46,.48,.42)))
        a.include('front_leg'+str(sx),rod(.014,start=(xx,y-.16,.46),end=(xx+sx*.025,y-.205,.025),color=(.46,.48,.42)))
    for i in range(6):
        xx=x+random.uniform(-width*.42,width*.42)
        a.include('backgrain'+str(i),box((.002,.001,.19),
                      center=(xx,y+.165,backheight-.13),color=(.51,.29,.11)))
    scene.include(name,a)

chair('chair behind middle desk',-.86,-1.29,.55,1.035)
chair('cropped left chair',-1.04,-4.08,.56,.77)
chair('cropped right chair',1.85,-4.03,.61,.74)

realize(scene)

# Procedural variations keep surfaces matte and naturally irregular.
def noise_finish(obj, low, high, scale=8, detail=3, stretch=None, bump=.0):
    if obj.type!='MESH' or not obj.data.materials:
        return
    mat=obj.data.materials[0].copy()
    obj.data.materials[0]=mat
    mat.use_nodes=True
    n=mat.node_tree.nodes
    l=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=n.get('Principled BSDF')
    bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.9
    tex=n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value=scale
    tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value=detail
    coord=n.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
    if stretch:
        vec=n.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
        vec.operation='MULTIPLY'
        vec.inputs[1].default_value=stretch
        l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],vec.inputs[0])
        l.new(vec.outputs[0],tex.inputs['Vector'])
    else:
        l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],tex.inputs['Vector'])
    ramp=n.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.15
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(*low,1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.85
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(*high,1)
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],ramp.inputs[0])
    l.new(ramp.outputs[0],bs.inputs['Base Color'])
    if bump:
        b=n.new('ShaderNodeBump')
        b.inputs['Strength'].default_value=bump
        b.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.018
        l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],b.inputs['Height'])
        l.new(b.outputs[0],bs.inputs['Normal'])

for obj in bpy.data.objects:
    name=obj.name.lower()
    if 'right_panel' in name:
        noise_finish(obj,(.025,.075,.038),(.13,.20,.105),5,3,(27,2,.6),.11)
    elif 'left_panel' in name:
        noise_finish(obj,(.027,.11,.055),(.10,.23,.13),5,4,(3,1,2),.08)
    elif 'blue_lower' in name:
        noise_finish(obj,(.009,.065,.22),(.019,.115,.32),5,4,None,.12)
    elif 'wall' in name and 'hook' not in name and 'notice' not in name:
        noise_finish(obj,(.72,.71,.64),(.85,.83,.75),5,3,None,.06)
    elif 'top' in name and 'rail' not in name:
        noise_finish(obj,(.68,.42,.14),(.91,.66,.29),4,2,(.6,18,1),.035)

# Camera is nearly square to the front wall.
set_view((0,-8.5,1.80),(0,0,1.80),lens=48,sensor=36)
camera=bpy.context.scene.camera
camera.data.clip_start=.05
camera.data.clip_end=100

area_emitter((-3.8,-4.0,5.0),power=850,size=4.0,target=(0,0,1.4),color=(1.0,.94,.81))
area_emitter((2.5,-4.0,3.4),power=110,size=4,target=(0,0,1.4),color=(.84,.89,1.0))
world=bpy.context.scene.world
world.use_nodes=True
world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Color'].default_value=(.72,.76,.80,1)
world.node_tree.nodes['Background'].inputs['Strength'].default_value=.42
render=bpy.context.scene
render.render.engine='CYCLES'
render.cycles.samples=64
render.render.resolution_x=512
render.render.resolution_y=337
render.render.resolution_percentage=100
render.view_settings.view_transform='Standard'
render.view_settings.look='Medium High Contrast'
render.view_settings.exposure=0
render.view_settings.gamma=1

def noise_finish(obj, low, high, scale=8, detail=3, stretch=None, bump=0):
    if obj.type!='MESH' or not obj.data.materials:
        return
    mat=obj.data.materials[0].copy()
    obj.data.materials[0]=mat
    mat.use_nodes=True
    n=mat.node_tree.nodes
    l=mat.node_tree.links
    bs=n.get('Principled BSDF')
    bs.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=.9
    tex=n.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    tex.inputs['Scale'].default_value=scale
    tex.inputs['Detail'].default_value=detail
    coord=n.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
    if stretch:
        vec=n.new('ShaderNodeVectorMath')
        vec.operation='MULTIPLY'
        vec.inputs[1].default_value=stretch
        l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],vec.inputs[0])
        l.new(vec.outputs[0],tex.inputs['Vector'])
    else:
        l.new(coord.outputs['Generated'],tex.inputs['Vector'])
    ramp=n.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position=.15
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(*low,1)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position=.85
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(*high,1)
    l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],ramp.inputs[0])
    l.new(ramp.outputs[0],bs.inputs['Base Color'])
    if bump:
        b=n.new('ShaderNodeBump')
        b.inputs['Strength'].default_value=bump
        b.inputs['Distance'].default_value=.018
        l.new(tex.outputs['Fac'],b.inputs['Height'])
        l.new(b.outputs[0],bs.inputs['Normal'])
